metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Flocon, the debugging tool for mobile apps

plugins.name: flocon
plugins.description: Let Claude debug your mobile app through Flocon Desktop (timeline, crashes, network calls, mocks and bad network, files, analytics, databases, preferences, feature flags, deeplinks, dashboards, tables, images, accessibility, WebView, screenshots and recordings), and set Flocon up or migrate it in Android, KMP, iOS and Flutter projects
